GCC and MinGW-w64 runtime libraries - MSYS2 Windows packages

Purpose: local dependencies of the bundled x86 CAPSIMG fallback.
GCC supplies libstdc++ and libgcc; MinGW-w64 supplies winpthreads.
The DLLs are unmodified files from official MSYS2 packages. Package URLs and
verified SHA-256 checksums are recorded in packages.json.

GCC project: https://gcc.gnu.org/
MinGW-w64 project: https://www.mingw-w64.org/
MSYS2 build recipes: https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages

GCC runtime package version: 16.2.0-6 (x86).
Source/build package:
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-gcc-16.2.0-6.src.tar.zst

Winpthreads package version: 14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-2 (x86).
Source/build package:
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-winpthreads-14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-2.src.tar.zst

Licenses retained from those packages:
- COPYING.GCC and COPYING.RUNTIME: GCC license and runtime library exception.
- COPYING.WINPTHREAD: winpthreads notices and license.
